summary: Meiwu Technology Company Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its wholly owned subsidiary, Xiamen Chunshang Health Technology Co., Ltd., completed its acquisition of 100% equity interests in Xiamen Hemeitong Commercial Co., Ltd. on September 22, 2026. Consideration was RMB235,200,000 (approximately $35 million) in cash, paid to two sellers under an equity transfer agreement dated August 20, 2026. Post-closing, Xiamen Hemeitong became a wholly owned indirect subsidiary. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or financing mechanics were disclosed. Watch integration execution, cash position impact, and any related-party or shell-company concerns.
